app_spm.menu.software_package.title: Packages
app_spm.menu.software_package.package_de: The following installation host list is the repository where the selected software package is located, and the host that has been configured with the repository will be displayed here.
app_spm.menu.repo.title: Warehouse
app_spm.menu.repo.repo_desc:
Software repository (Yum source) is used to manage software packages. The repository stores various rpm packages and dependencies between packages. Each host can configure its own warehouse. To avoid warehouse confusion, it is recommended to use a unified benchmark warehouse. 

It is recommended to configure a benchmark host for each operating system version, and configure the warehouse for that system version on it. The system will scan the warehouse configuration information on the benchmark host as the benchmark warehouse.

app_spm.menu.local_install.desc: If a package is not in the repository, you can choose to upload the package to the repository, and then select the package from the repository to install to the host.
